n = cdp('DOM.getDocument')['root']['nodeId']
nid = cdp('DOM.querySelector', nodeId=n, selector='#date')['nodeId']
bid = cdp('DOM.describeNode', nodeId=nid)['node']['backendNodeId']
cdp('DOM.focus', backendNodeId=bid)
for ch in "27122026":
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyDown', key=ch, text=ch, code=f'Digit{ch}')
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key=ch, code=f'Digit{ch}')
time.sleep(0.3)
print(js("return [document.getElementById('date').value, document.getElementById('date').validity.valid]"))

nid = cdp('DOM.querySelector', nodeId=n, selector='#time')['nodeId']
bid = cdp('DOM.describeNode', nodeId=nid)['node']['backendNodeId']
cdp('DOM.focus', backendNodeId=bid)
for k,c in [('0','Digit0'),('6','Digit6'),('0','Digit0'),('0','Digit0'),('P','KeyP')]:
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyDown', key=k, text=k, code=c)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key=k, code=c)
time.sleep(0.3)
print(js("return [document.getElementById('time').value, document.getElementById('time').validity.valid]"))

def setfield(sel, text):
    nid = cdp('DOM.querySelector', nodeId=n, selector=sel)['nodeId']
    bid = cdp('DOM.describeNode', nodeId=nid)['node']['backendNodeId']
    cdp('DOM.focus', backendNodeId=bid)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', commands=['selectAll'])
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA')
    type_text(text)
